merges.reason: KGMU is the acronym of King George's Medical University; both records are the same Lucknow institution (the alias record has no city). Canonical is the fuller name and is the record already matched to the NMC row 'King George Medical University, Lucknow'.

Both records are the Institute of Medical Sciences, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi - the only MBBS college of BHU. Canonical is the record already matched to the NMC row 'Institute of Medical Sciences, BHU, Varansi' and the only one carrying the city (Varanasi).
